mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy remains in an accommodative monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points above the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE monthly change exceeds 0.3pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive PAYEMS change, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face dual pressures from reduced output and labor costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market downturns (HOUST below 1500 thousand units), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and construction sector weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
